<style>.lx-el.e-con{--padding-top:0px;--padding-right:0px;--padding-bottom:0px;--padding-left:0px;--gap:0px;--row-gap:0px;--column-gap:0px;padding:0}.lx-el>.elementor-widget-html,.lx-el .elementor-widget-container{margin:0;padding:0}</style>
<!-- NEUROGENOMIC · Contacto (/contacto/). Formulario con respaldo sin JavaScript: POST a FormSubmit, nunca GET. -->
<style>
@font-face{font-family:'Big Shoulders Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk';font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Martian Mono';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}@font-face{font-family:'Martian Mono';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
/* NEUROGENOMIC · páginas interiores (Contacto, Privacidad) con el mismo sistema visual de la landing.
   Prefijo lx- y blindaje ante el tema de WordPress, igual que la portada. */
:root{
  --lx-bg:#050607;--lx-tx:#F2F3F0;--lx-tx2:#A3A8B0;--lx-line:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  --lx-lime:#C8FF00;--lx-s1:#0D0F11;
  --lx-disp:'Big Shoulders Display','Arial Narrow Bold',Impact,sans-serif;
  --lx-ff:'Schibsted Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --lx-mono:'Martian Mono',ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,monospace;
  --lx-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --lx-gut:clamp(18px,4.4vw,72px);
}
body:has(.lx-pg){margin:0;background:var(--lx-bg)}
.lx-pg{position:relative;min-height:100vh;background:var(--lx-bg);font:400 16px/1.6 var(--lx-ff);color:var(--lx-tx);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale}
.lx-pg *,.lx-pg *::before,.lx-pg *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.lx-pg :where(h1,h2,h3,p,ul,ol,li,dl,dt,dd,figure){margin:0;padding:0;font-size:inherit;font-weight:inherit;line-height:inherit;color:inherit;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit}
.lx-pg :where(ul,ol){list-style:none}
.lx-pg :where(a){color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.lx-pg :where(a):is(:hover,:focus,:active){color:inherit}
.lx-pg :where(button){font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;border-radius:0;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:inherit}
.lx-pg :where(button):is(:hover,:focus){background:none;color:inherit}
.lx-pg :where(input,select,textarea){font:inherit;margin:0}
.lx-pg :where(label){display:revert;font-weight:inherit;line-height:inherit}
.lx-pg :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lx-lime);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}
.lx-pg ::selection{background:var(--lx-lime);color:#050607}
.lx-sr{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.lx-pg::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(45% 40% at 80% 10%,rgba(200,255,0,.06),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(50% 50% at 10% 100%,rgba(120,140,160,.08),transparent 70%)}

/* Cabecera mínima: la marca vuelve a la portada (sin menú, igual que la landing) */
.lx-pg__top{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:22px var(--lx-gut);border-bottom:1px solid var(--lx-line)}
.lx-pg__brand{font:400 26px/1 var(--lx-disp);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em}
.lx-pg__brand b{font-weight:400;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-pg__back{font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.lx-pg__back:hover{color:var(--lx-lime)}}

.lx-pg__main{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(40px,8vh,96px) var(--lx-gut) clamp(56px,10vh,120px)}
.lx-k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:500 11px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-k b{font-weight:500;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-h{margin:18px 0 20px;font:400 clamp(46px,6.4vw,104px)/.9 var(--lx-disp);text-transform:uppercase;text-wrap:balance}
.lx-h em{font-style:normal;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-lead{max-width:56ch;font-size:clamp(17px,1.35vw,20px);line-height:1.5;color:#DADDE2}

/* Botón (mismo sistema) */
.lx-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--lx-lime);background:var(--lx-lime)!important;color:#050607!important;font:600 15px/1 var(--lx-ff);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s ease,box-shadow .3s var(--lx-out),transform .16s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.lx-btn[disabled]{opacity:.6;cursor:progress}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.lx-btn:hover{background:#D9FF4D!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,255,0,.16)}}

/* ---------- Contacto ---------- */
.lx-ct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:start;margin-top:clamp(28px,5vh,56px)}
.lx-ch{display:grid;gap:12px}
.lx-ch a,.lx-ch div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid var(--lx-line);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(13,15,17,.7)}
.lx-ch span{font:500 10.5px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-ch strong{font:500 clamp(18px,1.6vw,22px)/1.2 var(--lx-ff);color:var(--lx-lime);word-break:break-word}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.lx-ch a:hover{border-color:rgba(200,255,0,.5)}}
.lx-next{margin-top:28px;border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line)}
.lx-next h2{margin:22px 0 12px;font:500 11px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-next li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--lx-line);font-size:15px;color:#DADDE2}
.lx-next li b{font:500 11px/1.6 var(--lx-mono);color:var(--lx-lime)}

.lx-cf{display:grid;gap:16px;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,32px);border:1px solid var(--lx-line);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(13,15,17,.85)}
.lx-cf__2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.lx-f{display:grid;gap:8px}
.lx-f>label,.lx-f>span{font:500 10.5px/1.3 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-f i{font-style:normal;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-pg .lx-f :is(input,select,textarea){width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid rgba(242,243,240,.35);border-radius:6px;background:#0A0B0D;color:var(--lx-tx);font:400 16px/1.4 var(--lx-ff);outline:0;box-shadow:none;transition:border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .3s var(--lx-out)}
.lx-pg .lx-f textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical}
.lx-pg .lx-f select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,#C8FF00 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,#C8FF00 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 50%,calc(100% - 14px) 50%;background-size:6px 6px;background-repeat:no-repeat;padding-right:40px}
.lx-pg .lx-f :is(input,select,textarea):focus{border-color:var(--lx-lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,255,0,.12)}
.lx-pg .lx-f .is-err{border-color:#FF6B57}
.lx-pg .lx-f ::placeholder{color:#6F757E}
.lx-ck{display:flex!important;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--lx-tx2);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer}
.lx-ck input{flex:0 0 auto;width:18px;height:18px;margin:2px 0 0;accent-color:#C8FF00}
.lx-ck a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;color:var(--lx-tx)}
.lx-st{min-height:1.5em;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-st.is-ok{color:var(--lx-lime)}.lx-st.is-err{color:#FF8A78}
.lx-cf.is-sent .lx-cf__fields{display:none}

/* ---------- Privacidad ---------- */
.lx-pv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);margin-top:clamp(28px,5vh,56px);align-items:start}
.lx-toc{position:sticky;top:24px;display:grid;gap:2px;font:500 10.5px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lx-toc a{display:block;padding:7px 0;color:var(--lx-tx2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--lx-line)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.lx-toc a:hover{color:var(--lx-lime)}}
.lx-doc{max-width:72ch}
.lx-doc section{padding:28px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line);scroll-margin-top:20px}
.lx-doc section:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.lx-doc h2{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:14px;font:400 clamp(28px,2.6vw,40px)/1 var(--lx-disp);text-transform:uppercase}
.lx-doc h2 b{font:500 11px/1 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-doc h3{margin:18px 0 8px;font:600 16px/1.35 var(--lx-ff);color:#fff}
.lx-doc p{margin:0 0 12px;color:#DADDE2}
.lx-doc ul{margin:0 0 12px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.lx-doc ul li{position:relative;padding-left:18px;color:#DADDE2}
.lx-doc ul li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.72em;width:8px;height:1px;background:var(--lx-lime)}
.lx-doc strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.lx-doc a{color:var(--lx-lime);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.lx-tbl{width:100%;margin:6px 0 14px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14.5px}
.lx-tbl th,.lx-tbl td{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--lx-line);text-align:left;vertical-align:top;color:#DADDE2}
.lx-tbl th{font:500 10.5px/1.3 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.lx-box{margin:6px 0 14px;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid rgba(200,255,0,.3);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(200,255,0,.04)}
.lx-box p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.lx-upd{font:500 10.5px/1.4 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}

/* Pie (igual que la portada) */
.lx-foot{position:relative;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px 24px;padding:26px var(--lx-gut);border-top:1px solid var(--lx-line);font:500 10.5px/1.6 var(--lx-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lx-tx2)}
.lx-foot__l{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px}
.lx-foot a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.lx-foot a[href^="mailto:"]{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--lx-lime)}

@media (max-width:860px){
  .lx-ct,.lx-pv{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .lx-toc{position:static;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:16px}
  .lx-cf__2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .lx-tbl{font-size:13.5px}
  .lx-tbl th,.lx-tbl td{padding:8px}
}
@media (max-width:420px){.lx-toc{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lx-pg__back span{display:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lx-pg *{transition:none!important}}

</style>
<div class="lx-pg" data-lx-contacto>
  <header class="lx-pg__top">
    <a class="lx-pg__brand" href="/" aria-label="Neurogenomic, volver a la portada">Neuro<b>genomic</b></a>
    <a class="lx-pg__back" href="/">← <span>Volver a la </span>portada</a>
  </header>

  <main class="lx-pg__main">
    <p class="lx-k"><b>Contacto</b> Diagnóstico inicial</p>
    <h1 class="lx-h">¿Construimos tu próxima decisión <em>con evidencia?</em></h1>
    <p class="lx-lead">Cuéntanos qué quieres evaluar: una marca, una campaña, un packaging o un sitio web. Revisamos el desafío y te proponemos el método adecuado.</p>

    <div class="lx-ct">
      <div>
        <div class="lx-ch">
          <a href="mailto:contacto@neurogenomic.cl"><span>Correo</span><strong>contacto@neurogenomic.cl</strong></a>
          
          
        </div>
        <div class="lx-next">
          <h2>Qué pasa después</h2>
          <ol>
            <li><b>01</b><span>Revisamos tu mensaje y lo que quieres evaluar.</span></li>
            <li><b>02</b><span>Te escribimos para coordinar un diagnóstico inicial.</span></li>
            <li><b>03</b><span>Te proponemos método, alcance y entregables.</span></li>
          </ol>
        </div>
      </div>

      <form class="lx-cf" method="post" action="https://formsubmit.co/cristiangm3005@gmail.com" data-endpoint="https://formsubmit.co/ajax/cristiangm3005@gmail.com" aria-describedby="lx-cf-st">
        <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="Contacto · neurogenomic.cl">
        <input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">
        <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="false">
        <input type="hidden" name="Origen" value="Página de contacto">
        <div class="lx-cf__fields" style="display:grid;gap:16px">
          <div class="lx-cf__2">
            <div class="lx-f"><label for="cf-nombre">Nombre <i>*</i></label><input id="cf-nombre" name="Nombre" type="text" autocomplete="name" required maxlength="120"></div>
            <div class="lx-f"><label for="cf-correo">Correo <i>*</i></label><input id="cf-correo" name="email" type="email" inputmode="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="tu@empresa.cl" required maxlength="160"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="lx-cf__2">
            <div class="lx-f"><label for="cf-empresa">Empresa</label><input id="cf-empresa" name="Empresa" type="text" autocomplete="organization" maxlength="120"></div>
            <div class="lx-f"><label for="cf-tema">Qué quieres evaluar</label>
              <select id="cf-tema" name="Tema"><option value="">Elige una opción</option><option>Marca</option><option>Campaña o pieza publicitaria</option><option>Packaging</option><option>Sitio web o e-commerce</option><option>Otro</option></select></div>
          </div>
          <div class="lx-f"><label for="cf-msg">Mensaje <i>*</i></label><textarea id="cf-msg" name="Mensaje" required maxlength="3000" placeholder="Cuéntanos el desafío, el plazo y cualquier dato útil."></textarea></div>
          <label class="lx-ck"><input type="checkbox" name="Consentimiento" value="Sí" required> <span>Acepto que Neurogenomic use estos datos solo para responder mi solicitud, según la <a href="/privacidad/">política de privacidad</a>.</span></label>
          <div class="lx-sr" aria-hidden="true"><label for="cf-hp">No completar</label><input id="cf-hp" name="_honey" type="text" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></div>
          <div><button class="lx-btn" type="submit">Enviar mensaje <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button></div>
        </div>
        <p class="lx-st" id="lx-cf-st" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </form>
    </div>
  </main>

  <footer class="lx-foot"><span>© 2026 Neurogenomic · Una empresa de Genomic Industries SpA</span><span class="lx-foot__l"><a href="mailto:contacto@neurogenomic.cl">contacto@neurogenomic.cl</a><a href="/">Portada</a><a href="/privacidad/">Privacidad y datos</a></span></footer>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var f = document.querySelector('[data-lx-contacto] .lx-cf');
  if (!f || f.getAttribute('data-init')) return;
  f.setAttribute('data-init', '1');
  f.noValidate = true; // con JS se valida y envía sin salir de la página; sin JS, el navegador valida y envía por POST
  var st = f.querySelector('.lx-st'), bt = f.querySelector('button[type=submit]');
  var say = function (m, cls) { st.textContent = m; st.className = 'lx-st' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : ''); };
  var req = [].slice.call(f.querySelectorAll('[required]'));
  req.forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener('input', function () { el.classList.remove('is-err'); el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'); }); });
  f.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (f.querySelector('[name=_honey]').value) return;
    var bad = null;
    req.forEach(function (el) {
      var ok = el.type === 'checkbox' ? el.checked : el.type === 'email' ? /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(el.value.trim()) : el.value.trim().length > 1;
      el.classList.toggle('is-err', !ok); if (!ok) { el.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); if (!bad) bad = el; } else el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    });
    if (bad) { say(bad.type === 'checkbox' ? 'Necesitamos tu autorización para responderte.' : bad.type === 'email' ? 'Escribe un correo válido, por ejemplo nombre@empresa.cl.' : 'Completa los campos marcados con *.', 'is-err'); bad.focus(); return; }
    var data = {}; [].forEach.call(f.elements, function (el) { if (el.name && el.name !== '_honey' && (el.type !== 'checkbox' || el.checked)) data[el.name] = el.value; });
    data._replyto = data.email; data['Página'] = location.href;
    bt.disabled = true; say('Enviando…');
    fetch(f.getAttribute('data-endpoint'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(data) })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (j) { if (!r.ok || String(j.success) === 'false') throw new Error(); }); })
      .then(function () { f.classList.add('is-sent'); say('Gracias. Recibimos tu mensaje y te escribiremos a ' + data.email + '.', 'is-ok'); })
      .catch(function () { bt.disabled = false; say('No pudimos enviar el mensaje. Inténtalo de nuevo o escríbenos a contacto@neurogenomic.cl.', 'is-err'); });
  });
})();
</script>
